_why: THE table for how a column-backed FilterDef compiles (C4, rule 16), read by both languages: pytest pins toolkit/filter_compiler._KIND_SQL to `sql`, vitest pins registryQueryBuilder's dispatch to `postgrest` (a list value) and `postgrest_single` (a one-element list must be .eq(), never .in(): the planner rule in registryQueryBuilder.ts). `enum_or_unknown` and a null kind are hand-coded on Browse, and so is every id in `property_grain_clauses`: a filter a property-grain relation spells in its own shape whatever its kind (MS19's portal rule: toolkit/filter_compiler PROPERTIES_GRAIN.clauses for the Watchdog, queries.ts applyPortalRule for Browse).
